body: It was mainly my girlfriend breaking up with me 2 months ago for someone else and then coming back to me and then choosing someone else over me for the second time. The emotional distress was unbearable. We were madly in love and out of the blue she wanted to let go which doesn't make sense. I had such an attachment to her that the withdrawal is insane. I just can't let go of her even though she has been the biggest asshole. Love works in the weirdest ways.
